not seized and controlled; "unoccupied areas of France"

unoffending#adjective.meaning: adj. 不惹人生气的, 不冒犯人的, 无害的

englishDefinitions.definition: not offending; "an unoffending motorist should not have been stopped"

unofficial#adjective.meaning: adj. 非正式的, 非官方的

englishDefinitions.definition: not having official authority or sanction; "a sort of unofficial mayor"; "an unofficial estimate"; "he participated in an unofficial capacity"

unofficially#adverb.meaning: adv. 非公认地；非正式地

englishDefinitions.definition: not in an official capacity; "unofficially, he serves as the treasurer"
without official authorization; "he had made some money on the side"

unoiled#adjective.meaning: adj. 未加油的, 未上油的, 未涂油的

englishDefinitions.definition: in need of oil treatment; "dusty unoiled roads"; "a dull unoiled table"
not opposable

unorganized#adjective.meaning: adj. 未组织起来的, 没有组织的, 没编成的

englishDefinitions.definition: not having or belonging to a structured whole; "unorganized territories lack a formal government"

unoriginal#adjective.meaning: adj. 非原先的, 无独创精神的, 模仿的, 抄袭的

englishDefinitions.definition: not original; not being or productive of something fresh and unusual; "the manuscript contained unoriginal emendations"; "his life had been unoriginal, conforming completely to the given pattern"- Gwethalyn Graham

unorthodox#adjective.meaning: adj. 非正统的, 异教的

englishDefinitions.definition: breaking with convention or tradition; "an unorthodox lifestyle"

unostentatious#adjective.meaning: adj. 不虚饰的, 朴素的

englishDefinitions.definition: not ostentatious; "his unostentatious office"; "unostentatious elegance"
